title: SlipSlopes contract rule
description: One liquidity-relevant rule stated in a contract. clause_text must be verbatim from the source document. Values describe what the document states; a maximum (cap) is never a guaranteed payout. Discretion, conditions and exceptions are kept, not resolved.

source_page.description: 1-based physical PDF page; null when the source has no meaningful page

printed_page.description: Page label printed on the page, if detected

source_section.description: Heading, section number or prospectus supplement the clause sits in

unit.description: e.g. '% of aggregate NAV', 'business days', '% per annum'

value_kind.description: maximum = a cap the issuer/lender may fill less of; never treat as a guaranteed amount

conditions.description: Conditions under which the rule applies

discretion.description: Who may change, waive or suspend the rule (board, lender, general partner) and how

effective_period.description: Period the value applies to, e.g. 'per calendar month', 'per quarterly offer'

verification_status.description: unverified = automatic output; quote_matched = clause_text found verbatim on source_page by script; source_checked = value/conditions read against the source page by a reviewer and quote matched; human_verified = signed off by a named person
